crossRefs.note: Yahweh gave them rest all around, according to all that he swore to their fathers. Not a man of all their enemies stood…
and Ebron, Rehob, Hammon, and Kanah, even to great Sidon.
Canaan became the father of Sidon (his firstborn), Heth,
“Zebulun will dwell at the haven of the sea. He will be for a haven of ships. His border will be on Sidon.
and Hamath, also, which borders on it; Tyre and Sidon, because they are very wise.
all the inhabitants of the hill country from Lebanon to Misrephoth Maim, even all the Sidonians. I will drive them out…
crossRefs.keyword: Misrephoth-maim. or, salt pits. Heb. burning of waters

people.name: Israel
people.line: Patriarch, son of Isaac, father of twelve tribes

people.name: Misrephoth-maim
people.line: A place near Sidon where the Canaanites fled

translations.web: Yahweh delivered them into the hand of Israel, and they struck them, and chased them to great Sidon, and to Misrephoth Maim, and to the valley of Mizpah eastward. They struck them until they left them no one remaining.
translations.bsb: and the LORD delivered them into the hand of Israel, who struck them down and pursued them all the way to Greater Sidon and Misrephoth-maim, and eastward as far as the Valley of Mizpeh. They struck them down, leaving no survivors.
translations.kjv: And the LORD delivered them into the hand of Israel, who smote them, and chased them unto great Zidon, and unto Misrephothmaim, and unto the valley of Mizpeh eastward; and they smote them, until they left them none remaining.
translations.asv: And Jehovah delivered them into the hand of Israel, and they smote them, and chased them unto great Sidon, and unto Misrephoth-maim, and unto the valley of Mizpeh eastward; and they smote them, until they left them none remaining.
